webSearch.label: Web Search

webSearch.description: Search the web with an LLM provider's built-in web search or a configured Search API. Auto mode prefers LLM search and falls back to API search as configured.
webSearch.query: The search query or question to answer
webSearch.mode: Search mode: auto, llm, or api
webSearch.provider: API search provider; used as the fallback provider in auto mode
webSearch.maxResults: Number of API search results, from 1 to 10
webSearch.urls: Additional URLs to analyze with model search, up to 20
webSearch.unsupported: The current or configured model does not support LLM web search.
webSearch.urlsRequireLlm: API search does not support urls. Use llm mode, url_context, or web_fetch.
webSearch.fallbackFailed: LLM search failed: {llm}; API fallback ({provider}) failed: {api}
urlContext.description: Analyze up to 20 public URLs with built-in URL Context from Google Gemini Developer API or Vertex Express; public YouTube URLs are handled as video input.
urlContext.query: Question or task to perform on the URLs
urlContext.urls: Public URLs to analyze, from 1 to 20
urlContext.unsupported: url_context requires a Google Gemini Developer API or Vertex Express model. Current model: {model}.
urlContext.unverified: Provider {provider} returned no verified URL Context metadata. Treat the answer as ungrounded unless tool details contain sources or retrieved URLs.
urlContext.singleYouTube: Gemini supports only one public YouTube URL per request. Call url_context separately for each video.
output.moreResults: There are {count} more results in tool details.
